card.name: Slot before a serving size or quantity
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces or small words right before a portion or size amount, such as 3.5 ounces, 1/2 cup, per pound, or the size of the room. Mostly in food tables listing a food and its serving.

modes.label: Food table serving
modes.description: The comma, space or digit between a food name and its serving amount in a nutrient table.

modes.label: Per-unit or size phrase
modes.description: A small word that leads into a unit price or the size of something.
modes.example: a nice salmon fillet to net around $20<< per>> pound.

card.writes: It promotes the word size and its translations, so it anticipates a size or dimension word coming next.
card.plain: It fires where a serving or size amount is about to be given, as in a food table.
